These winged creatures lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and had sharp beak-like snouts, crests on their heads, small ears, four paws, grayish-white skin and long tails. They were probably very rare, or were discovered just not long before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of Alderaan, as [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologists]] never had an opportunity to identify the name of the creature or to study its habits properly. It was believed, though, that it fed on [[Nectar/Legends|nectar]] and [[Insect/Legends|insects]] — including some large ones, like [[Alderaan furry moth|woolly moths]]. These creatures became extinct, along with many other species of the Alderaanian fauna, after the destruction of Alderaan in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="WOSWFG" />
